title: Grim Reaper and Dragon Mask
description: A surreal cosmic scene features a large cracked white mask with one glowing orange eye and one purple eye, with a vibrant blue and gold Eastern dragon coiled around it. To the right, the Grim Reaper in a purple hooded robe holds a glowing green orb and a scythe whose blade merges with a melting clock face, surrounded by dancing skeletons, red lanterns, and swirling purple and blue vortexes.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene with a large cracked porcelain mask floating in a swirling cosmic vortex, one eye glowing orange and the other purple with colorful liquid dripping down. A vibrant blue and gold Chinese dragon coils around the mask. On the right, the Grim Reaper in a flowing purple robe holds a glowing green orb and a large scythe that merges into a melting clock face with Roman numerals. Several dancing skeletons at the bottom, red paper lanterns floating in the background, dramatic lighting, intricate details.
